description: This file implements quantized embedding bag operations for CPU in PyTorch, including fallback implementations, NEON-optimized routines for ARM architectures, and integration with FBGEMM for optimized matrix multiplication. It defines functions for different quantization bit widths (2, 4, 8 bits) and handles various data types and offsets, supporting pruned weights and sparse representations.
